PLEADINGS 1.
This DAR was filed on 24/05/2019 by Investigation Officer (IO) before this Tribunal in the presence of the parties.

The DAR was prepared by IO in respect of a motor vehicular accident dated 22/11/2018 which took place at Outer Ring Road, Majnu Ka Tilla, Delhi falling within the jurisdiction of PS Subzi Mandi in which one Sh. Riyasat Ali S/o Sh. Ramjan Baksh (hereinafter referred to as "deceased") sustained fatal injuries.

As per PW-3 Smt. Rajni (eye witness), she deposed that on dated 22.11.2018 at about 07:15 AM, she was going to Baraf Khana Chowk, Subzi Mandi, Delhi and there one vehicle/car bearing no. DL-4CAB-3383 (hereinafter referred to as "offending vehicle") which was driven by respondent Amrit Lal in rash and negligent manner and in a very high speed, hit the rickshaw of deceased Riyasat Ali S/o Sh. Ramjan Baksh and her also due to the said collision.
She further deposed that she sustained injuries and due to the said impact,
Riyasat Ali was got dead and the respondent left the spot leaving behind the abovesaid vehicle on the spot and thereafter, I registered FIR No. 332/2018, PS Subzi Mandi.
Respondent is stated to be driver-cum-owner of the offending vehicle.
DAR was treated as a claim petition.
Respondent was directed to file his Written Statement.

sentences.text: Having ruled so, this Tribunal now proceeds to assess the wrongful act, neglect or default of respondent, if any, in driving the offending vehicle at the relevant time.
Admittedly, Respondent has not explained the circumstances under which the accident took place due to his rash and negligent driving.

In the absence of any evidence regarding any mechanical defect in the offending vehicle or any material depicting any negligent/sudden act or omission on the part of the deceased, the only inference possible in the given facts and circumstances is that of neglect and default on the part of respondent while driving the offending vehicle at the relevant time.

In view of the above discussion,
this Tribunal is constrained to hold respondent guilty of gross neglect and default in driving the offending vehicle at the relevant time.
